zeroTierJoinHelp: Join a ZeroTier network without a system TUN device. Approve this node in the ZeroTier controller before using the outbound. Managed IPv4/IPv6 addresses and MTU come from the controller. Identity state is saved under yuhaiin's data directory so rejoining does not require authorizing a new device each time. Use distinct identity names for concurrent clients. The UDP underlay connects directly, so do not chain an upstream outbound before this protocol.
zeroTierNativeLibraryHelp: The native library must be available for the target OS and CPU. On macOS it must be installed as a signed application library; Android builds need libztgo.so in jniLibs. The library path is primarily for development and native diagnostics.
